_about: The knowledge graph's material chain (docs/NEWS_IMPACT_PLAN.md, phase 1): which products are made from which, by HS code, per industry, and the materials (species) news and supplier documents name. Hand-written from the sources below; every link cites one. data/eudr_products.json adds the official commodity → product links (EUDR Annex I). Loaded by seed_reference_data. aiCheck: who checked a link (an AI so far), its verdict and why. secondary: a path through the link is used only when no equally short path avoids it.

eudr-annex-i.title: EU Deforestation Regulation (EU) 2023/1115, Annex I (consolidated 18 September 2026)

industries.name: Wood and wooden furniture
industries.genericTermsNote: Broad words news uses for this industry's materials: each stands for every material whose woodType is listed (empty: all). A more specific word in the same phrase wins ('tropical timber' over 'timber'); a named species wins over all of them.

products.name: Seats with wooden frames, and their wooden parts
Wooden furniture (office, kitchen, bedroom, other) and parts

links.quote: SAWNWOOD … Wood that has been produced from both domestic and imported roundwood, either by sawing lengthways or by a profile-chipping process and that exceeds 6 mm in thickness.

aiCheck.note: Sawmills saw logs into lumber; the FAO definition says so directly.

links.quote: INDUSTRIAL ROUNDWOOD (WOOD IN THE ROUGH) … it is an aggregate comprising sawlogs and veneer logs; pulpwood, round and split; and other industrial roundwood.

aiCheck.note: Veneer is peeled or sliced from veneer logs; the quote lists veneer logs as part of roundwood.

links.quote: PLYWOOD … A panel consisting of an assembly of veneer sheets bonded together with the direction of the grain in alternate plies generally at right angles.

aiCheck.note: Plywood is veneer sheets glued in crossed plies; the FAO definition says so directly.

links.quote: It includes … core plywood or blockboard (plywood with a solid core (i.e. the central layer, generally thicker than the other plies) that consists of narrow boards, blocks or strips

aiCheck.note: Core plywood and blockboard have a core of sawn strips; most plywood is all veneer.

links.quote: WOOD CHIPS AND PARTICLES Wood that has been reduced to small pieces and is suitable for pulping, for particle board and/or fibreboard production, for use as a fuel, or for other purposes.

aiCheck.note: Logs are chipped for pulp and panels; the FAO definition covers chips made from wood.

links.quote: WOOD RESIDUES … It includes wood waste and scrap not useable as timber such as sawmill rejects, slabs, edgings and trimmings, veneer log cores, veneer rejects, sawdust, residues from carpentry and joinery production

aiCheck.note: Sawing logs leaves slabs, edgings and sawdust, as the FAO residue definition lists.

links.quote: WOOD RESIDUES … It includes wood waste and scrap not useable as timber such as sawmill rejects, slabs, edgings and trimmings, veneer log cores, veneer rejects, sawdust

aiCheck.note: Peeling leaves log cores and veneer rejects, as the FAO residue definition lists.

links.quote: WOOD RESIDUES INCLUDING WOOD FOR AGGLOMERATES … and wood residues that will be used for production of pellets and other agglomerated products.

aiCheck.note: Pellets are pressed from sawdust and residues; the FAO definition says so.

links.quote: PARTICLE BOARD, ORIENTED STRANDBOARD (OSB) AND SIMILAR BOARD A panel manufactured from small pieces of wood or other ligno-cellulosic materials (e.g. chips, flakes, splinters, strands, shreds, shives, etc.) bonded together

aiCheck.note: Particle board and OSB are made from chips, flakes and strands.

links.quote: WOOD CHIPS AND PARTICLES Wood that has been reduced to small pieces and is suitable for pulping, for particle board and/or fibreboard production

aiCheck.note: MDF and HDF are made from wood fibres refined from chips.

links.quote: WOOD PULP Fibrous material prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles or residues by mechanical and/or chemical process

aiCheck.note: Pulpwood logs are pulped directly; the FAO definition names pulpwood.

links.quote: WOOD PULP Fibrous material prepared from pulpwood, wood chips, particles or residues by mechanical and/or chemical process

aiCheck.note: Mill chips and residues are a main pulp input; the FAO definition names them.

links.quote: WOOD PULP … for further manufacture into paper, paperboard, fibreboard or other cellulose products.

aiCheck.note: Paper and paperboard are made from pulp.

links.quote: SAWNWOOD … It excludes sleepers, wooden flooring, mouldings (sawnwood continuously shaped along any of its edges or faces, like tongued, grooved, rebated, V-jointed, beaded, moulded, rounded or the like)

aiCheck.note: Mouldings and unassembled flooring strips are sawn wood shaped along its edges or faces.

links.quote: VENEER SHEETS … It includes wood used for the manufacture of laminated construction material, furniture, veneer containers, etc.

aiCheck.note: Veneer is mostly a surface on furniture (over particle board, MDF or plywood), rather than its main material, so a path through sawn wood or panels is preferred when both are as short.

links.basis: Heading 9403 'Other furniture and parts thereof', subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture …'; solid-wood furniture is made from sawn wood (4407).

aiCheck.note: Solid wood furniture (tables, beds, chairs' frames) is made from sawn wood.

links.basis: Subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture'; carcasses, cabinets and shelves are commonly plywood (4412).

aiCheck.note: Cabinet carcasses, shelves and drawer parts are commonly plywood.

links.basis: Subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture'; flat-pack and cabinet furniture is commonly particle board (4410).

aiCheck.note: Flat-pack and cabinet furniture is commonly particle board.

links.basis: Subheadings 9403.30–9403.60 'Wooden furniture'; cabinet doors and carcasses are commonly MDF (4411).

aiCheck.note: Cabinet doors and carcasses are commonly MDF.

links.basis: Subheadings 9401.61 / 9401.69 'Other seats, with wooden frames'; frames are made from sawn wood (4407).

aiCheck.note: Wooden seat frames are made from sawn wood.

links.basis: Subheading 9401.61 'Other seats, with wooden frames: Upholstered'; sofa frames are commonly plywood (4412).

aiCheck.note: Upholstered sofa and chair frames are commonly plywood.

links.basis: Heading 4418 'Builders' joinery and carpentry of wood, including cellular wood panels, assembled flooring panels'; made from sawn wood (4407).

aiCheck.note: Doors, windows and assembled flooring are made from sawn wood.

links.basis: Heading 4418 includes assembled flooring panels and cellular wood panels, commonly with a plywood (4412) base.

aiCheck.note: Engineered flooring panels commonly have a plywood base.

links.basis: Heading 4418 includes assembled flooring panels; engineered flooring has a hardwood veneer top layer (4408).

aiCheck.note: Missing from the first pass: engineered flooring's top layer is veneer.

links.basis: Heading 4418 includes doors and their frames; flush and moulded doors are commonly faced with MDF or HDF (4411).

aiCheck.note: Missing from the first pass: door skins are commonly MDF or HDF.
